items.title: Apparently AI-Assisted Conviction Draft Compromised a Defendant's Fair-Trial Rights in Cali, Colombia
items.summary: A criminal defendant's lawyers found a draft conviction proposing 18 years in prison in the court file before closing arguments in Cali, Colombia. items.searchText: oof-aii-437009 udio allegedly copied copyrighted sound recordings without permission to train its generative ai models record labels and independent artists alleged that udio copied copyrighted recordings without permission and used them to train its generative music models. udio acknowledged that its training data presumably included recordings owned by the plaintiffs but argued the copying was fair use. plaintiffs alleged losses of licensing control and compensation and competition from ai-generated music. location not specified yt dlp, youtube, udio, synthetic media generation technology, synthetic audio generation technology, spotify, music streaming services obidenity® — origin-bound identity governance architecture pga™ — prediction governance architecture
